country_decisions: CFG-PH-001: notifiable conditions, reporting deadlines and authorised sources; the reporting programmes and their periods (none ship).
CFG-HLT-001: the institution that keeps public-health programmes (the publicHealth slot of the deployment profile, shipped empty; the health regulator stands in only provisionally).
CFG-DAT-001: the small-cell suppression threshold and the disclosure rules for aggregates (shipped unset).
CFG-HX-001: the exchange that passes aggregates to the authorised statistics service.

library.title: Approve a public-health risk communication
library.intro: Propose a message about a risk to the public or to a group, its audience, channels and areas, and the evidence it rests on. Two officials of the public-health authority approve it, and it is released exactly as approved. It never names a person or gives anyone's health details.
library.filled_by: An official of the public-health authority, at an office.

deviations.what: A message about a risk to the public or a group, resting on aggregate figures: no case, contact or person named, and no individual report, finding or determination
deviations.why: Approved aggregate public-health statistics and programme administration are in scope; individual public-health records are not.
deviations.rule: Owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1; CLAUDE.md Health: returns are aggregates

deviations.what: The approval is a decision of two officials of the public-health authority (the procedure's four-eyes step), neither of whom drafted the message; the message is released exactly as approved, its digest sealed with the approval
deviations.why: An authorised message is approved by a recorded act of officials, never a status field.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md: two officials for the platform minimum (lib/casework/dual-control-policy.ts); forms publication: human approvals are recorded acts of different signed-in officials

deviations.what: A risk communication is not a facility report: the figures it rests on are the programme's accepted returns (HLT-PH-015, HLT-PH-011), cited in the evidence basis
deviations.why: The facility report record belongs to the returns, not to the message.
deviations.rule: Institutional specification Part 2 §C.2 (Facility report): kept by the programme returns (lib/health/programmes/register.ts)

deviations.what: Passing aggregates to the statistics service is an exchange the nation approves (CFG-HX-001); none ships
deviations.why: Exchange services answer only for an approved purpose.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: exchange services (callService())

deviations.what: Owner: the public-health authority slot (publicHealth), which ships empty: until the nation names it, the health regulator slot (healthRegulation) stands in as a provisional owner (lib/nation/deployment.ts provisionalOwner()), never proof of legal competence
deviations.why: Authority comes only from the deployment profile; the nation names its public-health authority there, or the health regulator where its law gives it the returns (integration register 20.8, 20.14).
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: authorityFor(), never a ministry by name

deviations.what: Patient consent, emergency clinical access and a shared patient reference do not arise: the form carries no patient, clinical, treatment, diagnosis or individual health field
deviations.why: Allowed scope only: health facility and professional regulation and aggregate statistics.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Health: no patient or clinical field anywhere, no national patient record; owner's direction 2026-10-21 §1

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
